fields.label: Interest Type
fields.description: Off the Loan Type master. The rate and the term are there too.

fields.label: Loan Status
fields.description: Applied and Closed are the two a person imposes. The three in between follow the figures — sanctioned but not paid, paid but nothing recovered, recovering — and a chosen state that disagrees with them is refused rather than overwritten. See manna_hr.rules.loan_status.

fields.label: Amount Requested
fields.description: Separate from Sanctioned on purpose: the difference between the two is the sanction.

fields.label: Sanctioned Amount
fields.description: What the schedule is computed on. Not the same as disbursed — a sanctioned loan never paid out must not show as owing.

fields.label: Disbursed Amount
fields.description: What actually left the account. Kept apart from the sanction because the gap between them is a loan that was agreed and not yet paid, and that gap is the one thing a register must not round away.

fields.label: Opening Balance
fields.description: What was still owed the day this system took over. Loaded, never derived — the recoveries that produced it happened on Factor HR and are not here.

fields.label: Loan Required For
fields.options:
General
Medical Treatment - Specified Disease
Education
Housing
Vehicle
Marriage
Tour Advance
Other
fields.description: A tax field before it is a filing one: Rule 3(7)(i) exempts a loan for the medical treatment of a specified disease from the perquisite altogether.

fields.label: Recovered To Date
fields.description: The sum of the `Employee Loan Repayment` rows against this loan. Derived on save and never typed — two places to state one figure is two figures.

fields.label: Outstanding
fields.description: Opening balance plus disbursed, less recovered, floored at zero. Over-recovery is reported on its own rather than as a negative that prints as a credit.

fields.label: Loan Date
fields.description: When it was applied for. Not when it was paid.

fields.label: Deduction Start From
fields.description: The first payslip that carries an instalment. An advance paid mid-month is normally recovered from the month after.

fields.label: Payment Date
fields.description: Disbursement — the one date money actually moved on.

fields.label: Loan Account No
fields.description: The lender's own reference. Not the employee's bank account.

fields.label: Monthly Instalment
fields.description: Blank lets the schedule split the sanction evenly over the term. Set it to hold an instalment somebody agreed to that the arithmetic would not have produced.

fields.label: Repayment Schedule
fields.description: Built from the sanction, the term and the start month, and rebuilt only while nothing has been recovered — a schedule that rewrites itself under a loan somebody has been paying is a loan nobody can reconcile.

fields.label: Loan Completed
fields.description: Set by the schedule finishing, not by a person.

fields.label: Do Not Auto Complete
fields.description: The override, because a loan can finish its schedule and still be owed: a bounced deduction, a stopped month, an adjustment.
